lists.content:
• Drive growth and referral traffic by identifying opportunities across emerging and established platforms, including X, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, WhatsApp and new distribution channels.
  • Produce platform-specific content that drives engagement, conversation and clicks back to The Athletic.
  • Create and optimize reporter videos and other video content, crafting platform-specific copy to maximize reach and engagement.
  • Support live coverage of breaking news, major sporting events and tentpole moments across social and emerging platforms.
  • Monitor platform trends, audience behavior and algorithm changes, testing new formats and distribution strategies to maximize reach and traffic.
  • Analyze performance data to identify what's working, share insights with the newsroom and continually refine distribution strategies.
  • Collaborate with reporters, editors and audience teams to identify stories with the greatest off-platform potential and execute distribution plans.

  • Launch breaking news emails from stories trending in the football, general sports space.

• 1 to 3 years of experience in social media, sports media or publishing
  • A true passion for sports journalism and willingness to get stuck in when a huge story breaks/event happens
  • Demonstrated platform fluency on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit and WhatsApp in business/professional applications and experience managing large social channels
  • Video editing experience
  • Experience with graphic creation
  • Strong writing skills with a keen eye for detail and grammar
  • Demonstrable interest and knowledge of Premier League, European, international and women’s football, as well as a working knowledge of major US sports
  • Flexibility to work different shifts (early, late, weekends) around the sporting calendar, particularly European football
  • Knowledge of social media best practices & resources.
  • A positive attitude and a willingness to learn and develop

  • Collaborate with sport editors to launch coverage around breaking news.
  • Coordinate with reporters in the field and editors who are contributing to coverage.
  • Maintain strong understanding of style and story structure, with the ability to identify mistakes and to improve pieces as needed.
  • Collaborate with sport editors to plan ahead for coverage of key events, to coordinate daily assignments and to strategize on particular areas of coverage.

  • Demonstrated experience working with reporters, with managerial experience a bonus.
  • An ability and willingness to work nights and weekends.
  • Interest and knowledge across a range of different sports.

Powered by one of the largest global newsrooms in sports media, The Athletic brings sports fans the most comprehensive stories about the teams, sports and athletes they love. The Athletic’s newsroom of 500+ full-time staff delivers in-depth coverage of hundreds of professional and college teams across more than 47 North American markets and all 20 football clubs in the English Premier League, as well as many Championship clubs.
raw.descriptionBody:
About The Role

The Athletic is seeking a contract Senior Strategist to lead RFP responses and proactive proposals. This role is ideal for someone who has experience identifying insights, inspiring ideas, and authoring proposals that help drive revenue for key advertisers. 

Strategy is a team sport, and you will be an expert collaborator responsible for developing innovative, cross-platform marketing programs for advertisers in partnership with Sales, Planning, Program Management, Account Management, Editorial, and Creative teams. You will lead brainstorms, develop briefs, and create proposals that leverage compelling solutions for our advertising partners. 

Success requires a passion for big ideas expressed through media, a love of advertising, and a high standard for creating visual presentations. Previous experience in strategy or integrated marketing at a media company is essential. 

This is a maternity leave coverage between 10/12/26 - 3/25/27.
